Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Presence of blood and epithelial cells could reflect inflammation or contamination. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
